LanguageData.ST.RedAlert.ButtonDesc: Trigger a colony-wide red alert with siren and full readiness.
LanguageData.ST.YellowAlert.ButtonDesc: Trigger a colony-wide caution alert with a short cooldown.
LanguageData.ST.Aid.ButtonDesc: Request a limited Starfleet resupply drop (global cooldown).
LanguageData.ST.Aid.NeedsCommander: Requires a Commander or Captain on this map.
LanguageData.ST.Aid.RejectNoCommander: Aid request requires a Commander or Captain present.
LanguageData.ST.Promotion.NotEligible: This pawn is not eligible for promotion.
LanguageData.ST.Promotion.RequiresDays: Must wait {0} more days since the last promotion.
LanguageData.ST.Promotion.UniqueRoleTaken: Only one Captain per colony is allowed.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Ensign.Offer: Starfleet Command offers a performance review. Acceptance will result in a field promotion to **Ensign** and delivery of a commission pip.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Ensign.LetterText: A commission pip to **Ensign** has been delivered by supply drop.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.LJG.Offer: Performance review indicates readiness for promotion to **Lieutenant (jg)**. Accept to receive the commission pip.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.LJG.LetterText: A commission pip to **Lieutenant (jg)** has been delivered.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Lieutenant.Offer: Operational record supports promotion to **Lieutenant**. Accept to receive the commission pip.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Lieutenant.LetterText: A commission pip to **Lieutenant** has been delivered.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.LtCommander.Offer: Leadership assessment suggests promotion to **Lieutenant Commander**. Accept to receive the commission pip.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.LtCommander.LetterText: A commission pip to **Lieutenant Commander** has been delivered.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Commander.Offer: Command fitness review recommends promotion to **Commander**. Accept to receive the commission pip.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Commander.LetterText: A commission pip to **Commander** has been delivered.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Captain.Offer: Command authority review recommends promotion to **Captain**. Accept to receive the commission pip.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Captain.LetterText: A commission pip to **Captain** has been delivered.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Fail.Unique: Only one colonist may hold this rank.
LanguageData.ST.Promo.Ceremony.Obligation: A promotion ceremony for {PAWN_labelShort} has been scheduled.
LanguageData.STQ.LJG.Intro: Complete the following Starfleet tasks to qualify for lieutenant junior grade:
LanguageData.STQ.LJG.Start: Starfleet objectives issued: complete one medical OR science scan, a security sweep, and improve relations via diplomacy.
LanguageData.STQ.LJG.Complete: Objectives complete. A promotion pip has been authorized.
LanguageData.STQ.LJG.Alert.Label: LtJG objectives
LanguageData.STQ.LJG.Alert.Desc: Complete the following to receive authorization for promotion:
LanguageData.ST.Research.RedAlert.Label: red alert protocols
LanguageData.ST.Research.RedAlert.Desc: Implements colony-wide alert routing and EPS priority to enable the Red Alert panel.
LanguageData.ST.Diplo.Improve.Desc: Pay {0} silver to improve goodwill by +{1} with a non-hostile faction.
LanguageData.ST.Diplo.Improve.Confirm: Transmit cultural exchange package to {0} for {1} silver?\n\nExpected goodwill change: +{2}.
LanguageData.ST.Diplo.Ceasefire.Desc: Pay {0} silver to negotiate a ceasefire with a hostile faction.
LanguageData.ST.Diplo.Ceasefire.Confirm: Attempt ceasefire with {0} for {1} silver?\n\nIf successful, status will become neutral.
LanguageData.ST.Diplo.Requirements.Improve: Requires a {1} with Social {0}+ on this map.
LanguageData.ST.Diplo.Requirements.Ceasefire: Requires a {1} with Social {0}+ on this map.
LanguageData.ST.Ktarian.Play.Desc: Start a short neural-interface game session.
LanguageData.ST.Ktarian.Play.BlockedState: Pawn is unable to focus right now.
LanguageData.ST.Ktarian.Play.NeedsTalking: Pawn must be able to talk.
LanguageData.ST.Thought.KtarianCraving.Label: ktarian craving
LanguageData.ST.Thought.KtarianCraving.Desc: A lingering urge to return to the Ktarian game.
LanguageData.ST.Ktarian.Use.Desc: Immerse in a holographic puzzle experience.
LanguageData.ST.Ktarian.AddictionWarning: Careful: prolonged use may cause obsessive focus.
LanguageData.ST.Tricorder.Med.Scan.Desc: Perform a quick medical tricorder scan to improve recovery.
LanguageData.ST.Tricorder.Sci.Scan.Desc: Geological/environmental scan. Highlights resources and grants insight.
LanguageData.ST.Tricorder.Sci.OutOfRange: Target cell is out of range.
LanguageData.ST.Tricorder.Sec.Scan.Desc: Scan area for threats and gain combat awareness.
LanguageData.ST.Security.Sweep.Label: Security sweep
LanguageData.ST.Security.Sweep.Desc: Perform a short-range security sweep of the area.
LanguageData.ST.Transporter.BeamIn.Desc: Materialize a small care package at the beacon.
LanguageData.ST.Transporter.BeamOut.Desc: Teleport a colonist to the beacon. Causes brief nausea.
LanguageData.ST.Transporter.NearGravEngine.Required: A gravity engine (or its blueprint) must exist on this map.
LanguageData.ST.Transporter.NearGravEngine.TooFar: Must be placed within {0} tiles of the gravity engine.
